# Set up

Load needed packages, make sure they are installed.

```{r}
library(readr) 
library(dplyr) 
library(tidyverse) 
library(skimr) 
library(here)
library(tibble)
library(tidytext)
```

Load the data.

```{r}
#Path to data dictionary. Note the use of the here() package and not absolute paths
data_location <- here("Data","raw-data","TB_data_dictionary_2026-09-25.csv")
#load data dictionary
data_dictionary <- read_csv(data_location)

#Path to dataframes. 
data_location1 <- here("Data", "raw-data", "TB_burden_countries_2026-09-29.csv")
burden_data <- read_csv(data_location1)

data_location2 <- here("Data", "raw-data", "LTBI_estimates_2026-09-29.csv")
household_data <- read_csv(data_location2)

data_location3 <- here("Data", "raw-data", "TB_hiv_nonroutine_surveillance_2026-09-29.csv")
hiv_surveillance_data <- read_csv(data_location3)

data_location4 <- here("Data", "raw-data", "TB_contact_tpt_2026-09-29.csv")
contact_screening_data <- read_csv(data_location4)

data_location5 <- here("Data", "raw-data", "TB_policies_services_2026-09-29.csv")
policies_data <- read_csv(data_location5)

```

Use dictionary to make dataframes more readable

```{r}
##Full joining

join1 <- full_join(burden_data, contact_screening_data, by = c("country", "year"))

join2 <- full_join(hiv_surveillance_data, join1, by = c("country", "year"))

join3 <- full_join(household_data, join2, by = c("country", "year"))

full_join_data <- full_join(policies_data, join3, by = c("country", "year"))

#Only keeping the columns of interest 
full_data_small <- full_join_data %>% select("country", "year", "e_pop_num", "e_inc_num", "e_inc_tbhiv_num", "e_mort_exc_tbhiv_num", "e_mort_tbhiv_num", "e_mort_num", "cfr", "c_cdr", "tb_from_screen_available", "newinc_from_screen", "screen_data_available", "newinc_con", "newinc_con_screen", "newinc_con_tb", "prevtx_data_available.x", "newinc_con_prevtx.x", "hcw_tb_infected", "hcw_tot", "ident_pris", "newrel_prisoners", "plhiv_all_screen_data_available", "plhiv_all", "plhiv_all_screen", "prisoners_screen_data_available", "prisoners", "prisoners_screen", "miners_screen_data_available", "miners_screen", "miners", "district", "district_cxr", "district_wrd", "phcf", "phcf_wrd", "presumptive", "presumptive_wrd", "wrd_test_capacity", "m_wrd_error_rate_lte_5pct", "district_monitor_pos_rate", "m_wrd_tat_lt_48h")

#checking for empty rows, outside of the first two columns which will always be filled
empty_rows <- rowSums(is.na(full_data_small[, -c(1:2)]) | full_data_small[, -c(1:2)] == "") == ncol(full_data_small[, -c(1:2)])
any(empty_rows)    #all good

#checking for empty columns, outside of the first two columns which will always be filled
empty_cols <- colSums(is.na(full_data_small[, -c(1:2)]) | full_data_small[, -c(1:2)] == "") == nrow(full_data_small)
any(empty_cols)

full_data_small <- full_data_small %>% rename("Country" = "country", "Year" = "year", "Total Population" = "e_pop_num", "Incident TB Cases" = "e_inc_num", "Incident TB Among HIV Positive" = "e_inc_tbhiv_num", "TB Deaths (Excluding HIV)" = "e_mort_exc_tbhiv_num", "TB Deaths Among HIV Positive" = "e_mort_tbhiv_num", "All TB Deaths" = "e_mort_num", "Case Fatality Ratio" = "cfr", "Case Detection Rate" = "c_cdr", "Is Data on Cases Reported Through Screening Efforts Available?" = "tb_from_screen_available", "Number New/Relapse Cases Reported through Screening" = "newinc_from_screen", "Is Household Contact Data Available?" = "screen_data_available", "Number Household Contacts of Confirmed Cases" = "newinc_con", "Number Household Contacts Screened" = "newinc_con_screen", "Number Household Contacts with New Case" = "newinc_con_tb", "Is Data Available on Number of Household Contacts Started on Preventative?" = "prevtx_data_available.x", "Number HHC Cases after Preventative" = "newinc_con_prevtx.x", "Number of Healthcare Workers with TB" = "hcw_tb_infected", "Number of Healthcare Workers" = "hcw_tot", "Is Prisoner TB Data Available?" = "ident_pris", "Number New/Relapse Cases in Prisons" = "newrel_prisoners", "Is Data Available on Number of People with HIV Screened for TB?" = "plhiv_all_screen_data_available", "Number of People with HIV" = "plhiv_all", "Number of People with HIV Screened for TB" = "plhiv_all_screen", "Is Data Available on Number of Prisoners Screened for TB?" = "prisoners_screen_data_available", "Number of Prisoners" = "prisoners", "Number of Prisoners Screened for TB" = "prisoners_screen", "Is Data Available on Miners Exposed to Silica Dust Screened for TB?" = "miners_screen_data_available", "Number of Miners Screened for TB" = "miners_screen", "Number of Miners Exposed to Silica Dust" = "miners", "Total Number of Districts" = "district", "Number of Districts where Chest X-Ray Used for TB Screening" = "district_cxr", "Number of Districts with WHO Rapid Test Requirement" = "district_wrd", "Number of Primary Healthcare Facilities" = "phcf", "Number of PHCF with Access to WHO Rapid Test" = "phcf_wrd", "Number of People with Presumptive TB" = "presumptive", "Number of People with Presumptive TB Screened with WHO Rapid Test" = "presumptive_wrd", "Number of WHO Rapid Tests that can be Performed with Existing Equipment" = "wrd_test_capacity", "Number of Sites Providing WHO Rapid Test with Error Less Than 5%" = "m_wrd_error_rate_lte_5pct", "Number of Districts that Monitor Positivity Rate" = "district_monitor_pos_rate", "Number of Labs with 48hr Turnaround on 80% of Rapid Test Samples" = "m_wrd_tat_lt_48h")

```

Cleaning 
```{r}
##Major questions about screening at risk groups: Miners, Prisoners, Healthcare Workers, Househould Contacts, HIV

#Miners
df_miners <- full_data_small %>% filter(!is.na(`Is Data Available on Miners Exposed to Silica Dust Screened for TB?`)) %>% select("Country", "Year", "Total Population", "Incident TB Cases", "TB Deaths (Excluding HIV)", "All TB Deaths", "Case Fatality Ratio", "Case Detection Rate", "Is Data on Cases Reported Through Screening Efforts Available?", "Number New/Relapse Cases Reported through Screening", "Is Data Available on Miners Exposed to Silica Dust Screened for TB?", "Number of Miners Screened for TB", "Number of Miners Exposed to Silica Dust")

df_miners_yes <- df_miners %>% filter(`Is Data Available on Miners Exposed to Silica Dust Screened for TB?` == 1.00) 

#Prisoners
df_prisoners <- full_data_small %>% filter(!is.na(`Is Prisoner TB Data Available?`)) %>% select("Country", "Year", "Total Population", "Incident TB Cases", "TB Deaths (Excluding HIV)", "All TB Deaths", "Case Fatality Ratio", "Case Detection Rate", "Is Data on Cases Reported Through Screening Efforts Available?", "Number New/Relapse Cases Reported through Screening", "Is Prisoner TB Data Available?", "Number New/Relapse Cases in Prisons", "Is Data Available on Number of Prisoners Screened for TB?", "Number of Prisoners", "Number of Prisoners Screened for TB")

df_prisoners_yes <- df_prisoners %>% filter(`Is Prisoner TB Data Available?` == 1.00)

#Healthcare Workers
df_hcw <- full_data_small %>% filter(!is.na(`Number of Healthcare Workers`)) %>% select("Country", "Year", "Total Population", "Incident TB Cases", "TB Deaths (Excluding HIV)", "All TB Deaths", "Case Fatality Ratio", "Case Detection Rate", "Is Data on Cases Reported Through Screening Efforts Available?", "Number New/Relapse Cases Reported through Screening", "Number of Healthcare Workers with TB", "Number of Healthcare Workers")

#Household Contacts
df_hhc <- full_data_small %>% filter(!is.na(`Is Household Contact Data Available?`)) %>% select("Country", "Year", "Total Population", "Incident TB Cases", "TB Deaths (Excluding HIV)", "All TB Deaths", "Case Fatality Ratio", "Case Detection Rate", "Is Data on Cases Reported Through Screening Efforts Available?", "Number New/Relapse Cases Reported through Screening", "Is Household Contact Data Available?", "Number Household Contacts of Confirmed Cases", "Number Household Contacts Screened", "Number Household Contacts with New Case", "Is Data Available on Number of Household Contacts Started on Preventative?", "Number HHC Cases after Preventative")

df_hhc_yes <- df_hhc %>% filter(`Is Household Contact Data Available?` == 1.00 | `Is Household Contact Data Available?` == 60.00)

#HIV
df_hiv <- full_data_small %>% filter(!is.na(`Is Data Available on Number of People with HIV Screened for TB?`)) %>% select("Country", "Year", "Total Population", "Incident TB Cases", "TB Deaths (Excluding HIV)", "All TB Deaths", "Case Fatality Ratio", "Case Detection Rate", "Is Data on Cases Reported Through Screening Efforts Available?", "Number New/Relapse Cases Reported through Screening", "Incident TB Among HIV Positive", "TB Deaths Among HIV Positive", "Is Data Available on Number of People with HIV Screened for TB?", "Number of People with HIV", "Number of People with HIV Screened for TB")

df_hiv_yes <- df_hiv %>% filter(`Is Data Available on Number of People with HIV Screened for TB?` == 1.00)

##Major questions - Available technology

###df_tech <- full_join_small %>% I am commenting this out for now because I'm not sure if I need to include evaluation of the available technology in an area in the final project because I already have screening for at risk groups (hiv, hcw, miners, prisoner) and contact tracing and that already feels like a lot, will come back to this if necessary

```

Basic Exploration
```{r}
#Which countries are doing the screening
countries_miners_yes <- df_miners_yes %>% distinct(Country)
countries_prisoners_yes <- df_prisoners_yes %>% distinct(Country)
countries_hcw <- df_hcw %>% distinct(Country)
countries_hhc_yes <- df_hhc_yes %>% distinct(Country)
countries_hiv_yes <- df_hiv_yes %>% distinct(Country)

#and when 
reporting_by_year <- bind_rows(df_miners_yes %>% distinct(Country, Year) %>% mutate(Group = "Miners"), df_prisoners_yes %>% distinct(Country, Year) %>% mutate(Group = "Prisoners"), df_hcw %>% distinct(Country, Year) %>% mutate(Group = "Healthcare Workers"), df_hhc_yes %>% distinct(Country, Year) %>% mutate(Group = "Household Contacts"), df_hiv_yes %>% distinct(Country, Year) %>% mutate(Group = "People with HIV")) %>% count(Group, Year, name = "n_countries")

plot1 <- ggplot(reporting_by_year, aes(x = Year, y = n_countries)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  facet_wrap(~ Group, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Number of Countries Reporting Screening Data, by Year", x = "Year", y = "Number of countries")

ggsave(filename = "country_year_plot.png",
  plot = plot1,
  path = "Output")

#For each intervention
##miners
df_miners_cmp <- df_miners %>% filter(`Is Data Available on Miners Exposed to Silica Dust Screened for TB?` %in% c(0, 1)) %>% mutate(screen_data = factor(`Is Data Available on Miners Exposed to Silica Dust Screened for TB?`, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No screening data (0)", "Screening data available (1)")))

df_miners_test <- df_miners_cmp %>% mutate(mort_rate = `TB Deaths (Excluding HIV)` / `Total Population` * 100000) %>% filter(!is.na(`TB Deaths (Excluding HIV)`), !is.na(`Total Population`),`TB Deaths (Excluding HIV)` > 0)

###Commenting this graph out because I'm not convinced it tells me anything useful 
# df_miners_test %>% filter(Year %in% c(2023, 2024)) %>% group_by(Year) %>% slice_max(mort_rate, n = 20) %>% ungroup() %>%
  #ggplot(aes(x = reorder_within(Country, `mort_rate`, Year), y = mort_rate, fill = screen_data)) +
 # geom_col() +
  #coord_flip() +
  #facet_wrap(~ Year, scales = "free_y") +
  #scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
 # scale_fill_manual(values = c("No screening data (0)" = "firebrick", "Screening data available (1)" = "steelblue")) +
  #labs(title = "Mortality Rate by Country, 2023 vs. 2024", x = NULL, y = "Mortality Rate", fill = NULL) +
  #theme_minimal() +
  #theme(legend.position = "bottom")

plot2 <- ggplot(df_miners_test, aes(x = screen_data, y = mort_rate, fill = screen_data)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("firebrick", "steelblue"), guide = "none") +
  labs(title = "TB Mortality Rate: Countries With vs. Without Miner Screening Data",
       x = NULL, y = "TB Deaths per 100,000 (log scale)") +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave(filename = "country_miner_plot.png",
  plot = plot2,
  path = "Output")

wilcox.test(mort_rate ~ screen_data, data = df_miners_test)

df_miners_test <- df_miners_test %>% mutate(`Silica Testing Rate` = (`Number of Miners Screened for TB` / `Number of Miners Exposed to Silica Dust`) * 100)

plot3 <- ggplot(df_miners_test, aes(x = `Silica Testing Rate`, y = mort_rate)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = factor(Year)), size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(title = "TB Mortality Rate vs. Miner Screening Coverage", x = "% of silica-exposed miners screened", y = "TB Deaths per 100,000 (log scale)", color = "Year") +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave(filename = "miner_coverage_plot.png",
  plot = plot3,
  path = "Output")

cor.test(df_miners_test$`Silica Testing Rate`, df_miners_test$mort_rate, method = "spearman")

##prisoners
df_prisoners_cmp <- df_prisoners %>% filter(`Is Data Available on Number of Prisoners Screened for TB?` %in% c(0, 1)) %>% mutate(screen_data = factor(`Is Data Available on Number of Prisoners Screened for TB?`, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No screening data (0)", "Screening data available (1)")))

df_prisoners_test <- df_prisoners_cmp %>% mutate(mort_rate = `TB Deaths (Excluding HIV)` / `Total Population` * 100000) %>% filter(!is.na(`TB Deaths (Excluding HIV)`), !is.na(`Total Population`),`TB Deaths (Excluding HIV)` > 0)

plot4 <- ggplot(df_prisoners_test, aes(x = screen_data, y = mort_rate, fill = screen_data)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("firebrick", "steelblue"), guide = "none") +
  labs(title = "TB Mortality Rate: Countries With vs. Without Prisoner Screening Data",
       x = NULL, y = "TB Deaths per 100,000 (log scale)") +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave(filename = "country_prisoner_plot.png",
  plot = plot4,
  path = "Output")

wilcox.test(mort_rate ~ screen_data, data = df_prisoners_test)

df_prisoners_test <- df_prisoners_test %>% mutate(`Prisoner Testing Rate` = (`Number of Prisoners Screened for TB` / `Number of Prisoners`) * 100) %>% mutate(`Prisoner Incidence Rate` = (`Number New/Relapse Cases in Prisons` / `Number of Prisoners`) * 100) %>% mutate(`Prisoner Screen Positivity Rate` = (`Number New/Relapse Cases in Prisons` / `Number of Prisoners Screened for TB`) * 100)

plot5 <- ggplot(df_prisoners_test, aes(x = `Prisoner Testing Rate`, y = mort_rate)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = factor(Year)), size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(title = "TB Mortality Rate vs. Prisoner Screening Coverage", x = "% of prisoners screened", y = "TB Deaths per 100,000 (log scale)", color = "Year") +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave(filename = "prisoner_coverage_plot.png",
  plot = plot5,
  path = "Output")

cor.test(df_prisoners_test$`Prisoner Testing Rate`, df_prisoners_test$mort_rate, method = "spearman")

#Household contacts 
df_hhc_cmp <- df_hhc %>% mutate(screen_data = case_when(`Is Household Contact Data Available?` %in% c(1, 60) ~ "Screening data available", TRUE ~ "No screening data"))

df_hhc_cmp <- df_hhc_cmp %>% mutate(prev_screen_data = case_when(`Is Data Available on Number of Household Contacts Started on Preventative?` %in% c(1, 60) ~ "Preventative data available", TRUE ~ "No preventative data"))
df_hhc_cmp$prev_screen_data <- factor(df_hhc_cmp$prev_screen_data, levels = c("No preventative data", "Preventative data available"))

df_hhc_test <- df_hhc_cmp %>% mutate(mort_rate = (`TB Deaths (Excluding HIV)` / `Total Population`) * 100000) %>% filter(!is.na(`TB Deaths (Excluding HIV)`), !is.na(`Total Population`),`TB Deaths (Excluding HIV)` > 0)

plot6 <- ggplot(df_hhc_test, aes(x = screen_data, y = mort_rate, fill = screen_data)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("firebrick", "steelblue"), guide = "none") +
  labs(title = "TB Mortality Rate: Countries With vs. Without Household Contact Screening Data",
       x = NULL, y = "TB Deaths per 100,000 (log scale)") +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave(filename = "country_hhc_plot.png",
  plot = plot6,
  path = "Output")

wilcox.test(mort_rate ~ screen_data, data = df_hhc_test)

df_hhc_test <- df_hhc_test %>% mutate(`Household Contacts Testing Rate` = (`Number Household Contacts Screened` / `Number Household Contacts of Confirmed Cases`) * 100) %>% mutate(`HHC Incidence Rate` = (`Number Household Contacts with New Case` / `Number Household Contacts Screened`) * 100)

plot7 <- ggplot(df_hhc_test, aes(x = `Household Contacts Testing Rate`, y = mort_rate)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = factor(Year)), size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(title = "TB Mortality Rate vs. Household Contact Screening Coverage", x = "% of household contacts screened", y = "TB Deaths per 100,000 (log scale)", color = "Year") +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave(filename = "hhc_coverage_plot.png",
  plot = plot7,
  path = "Output")

cor.test(df_hhc_test$`Household Contacts Testing Rate`, df_hhc_test$mort_rate, method = "spearman")

plot8 <- ggplot(df_hhc_test, aes(x = prev_screen_data, y = mort_rate, fill = prev_screen_data)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.5, outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "text", aes(label = round(after_stat(y), 1)), vjust = -0.8, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("No preventative data" = "#E69F00", "Preventative data available" = "#0072B2"), guide = "none") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "TB Deaths per 100,000 (log scale)", title = "Mortality rate by availability of household contact preventative treatment data", caption = paste0("n = ", sum(df_hhc_test$prev_screen_data == "No preventative data"), " (no data), ", sum(df_hhc_test$prev_screen_data == "Preventative data available"), " (data available)")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)

ggsave(filename = "hhc_preventative_plot.png",
  plot = plot8,
  path = "Output")

wilcox.test(mort_rate ~ prev_screen_data, data = df_hhc_test)

#Healthcare workers - bailing on this category because there's no information about screening, just number of cases and number of healthcare workers

#HIV
df_hiv_cmp <- df_hiv %>% filter(`Is Data Available on Number of People with HIV Screened for TB?` %in% c(0, 1)) %>% mutate(screen_data = factor(`Is Data Available on Number of People with HIV Screened for TB?`, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("No screening data (0)", "Screening data available (1)")))

df_hiv_test <- df_hiv_cmp %>% mutate(mort_rate = (`TB Deaths (Excluding HIV)` / `Total Population`) * 100000) %>% filter(!is.na(`TB Deaths (Excluding HIV)`), !is.na(`Total Population`),`TB Deaths (Excluding HIV)` > 0) %>% mutate(screening_rate = ((`Number of People with HIV Screened for TB` / `Number of People with HIV`) * 100))

plot9 <- ggplot(df_hiv_test, aes(x = screen_data, y = mort_rate, fill = screen_data)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.15, alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("firebrick", "steelblue"), guide = "none") +
  labs(title = "TB Mortality Rate: Countries With vs. Without HIV Screening Data",
       x = NULL, y = "TB Deaths per 100,000 (log scale)") +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave(filename = "country_hiv_plot.png",
  plot = plot9,
  path = "Output")

wilcox.test(mort_rate ~ screen_data, data = df_hiv_test)

plot10 <- ggplot(df_hiv_test, aes(x = screening_rate, y = mort_rate)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = factor(Year)), size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "black", linewidth = 0.8) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(title = "TB Mortality Rate vs. HIV Screening Coverage", x = "% of people livingvwith HIV screened for TB", y = "TB Deaths per 100,000 (log scale)", color = "Year") +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave(filename = "hiv_coverage_plot.png",
  plot = plot10,
  path = "Output")

cor.test(df_hiv_test$screening_rate, df_hiv_test$mort_rate, method = "spearman")

```
